newsitem.title: CHINA: CNAC NOT INTERESTED IN CATHAY STAKE.
newsitem.headline: CNAC NOT INTERESTED IN CATHAY STAKE.

text.p: HONG KONG, Aug 7 (Reuter) China National Aviation Corp (Group) Ltd said on Thursday it was not currently interested in acquiring a stake in Hong Kong carrier Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd.
"We have not thought about it at the moment," CNAC (Group) vice president Zhang Xian Lin told reporters when asked whether CNAC was interested in buying a stake in Cathay.
Asked whether CNAC would acquire Cathay shares after CNAC's Hong Kong listing, he said, "We are not thinking about it. We are not interested."
Rumours have been circulating in the Hong Kong stock market that CNAC may buy a stake in Cathay from Citic Pacific Ltd. Zhang said this was not true.

CNAC plans to list shares in Hong Kong as soon as possible, Zhang said. The inclusion of Hong Kong Dragon Airlines Ltd was a possibility the company was looking at, but this had not been finalised, he said. CNAC owns 35.86 percent of Dragonair.
Zhang said China state-owned CNAC, which has invested more than HK$1.0 billion in airport facilities in Hong Kong, had already informed relevant Chinese authorities about its listing plans.
Stanley Hui, chief executive office of Dragonair, said the company had no plans to list shares in Hong Kong at the moment.
